lines.japanese: 「うわ、最低だな千歳。二代目狩男でも目指してんのか」
lines.english: “God, Chitose, you're despicable. Trying to become Karuo's heir?”

lines.japanese: 「あの、日和子さん？　いい加減こんな猿芝居を鵜呑みにはしませんよね？　そろそろ俺を信じてくれてもいい頃合ですよね？」
lines.english: “Um, Hiyoko? You're not going to fall for this little act again, are you? Isn't it about time you placed a little trust in me?”

lines.japanese: 「千歳さん」
lines.english: “Mr. Chitose.”

lines.japanese: 「は、はい」
lines.english: “Y-yes?”

lines.japanese: 「私、フロアを一巡したら休憩に入らせてもらいますので」
lines.english: “Once I've made a circuit of the floor, I'll be taking my break.”

lines.japanese: 「ど、どうぞ」
lines.english: “P-please do.”

lines.japanese: 「あーあ、おまえまーた、たまひよ怒らせたの」
lines.english: “Aw, Chitose. You made Tama-chick mad again.”

lines.japanese: 「千歳君はひよちゃんを怒らせてばっかりだね」
lines.english: “You really are always making Hiyo angry.”

lines.japanese: 「まったくです。そのうちの何割が冤罪なのか、彼女には一度確認していただきたいものですけどね」
lines.english: “Indeed. Though I’d like her to consider, just once, how many of those accusations were false.”

lines.japanese: 「なー？　せっかくたまひよの点数稼ごうと思って、つまんない小説まで読んだのにな」
lines.english: “Yeah? Even after you went so far as to read those boring novels just to score points with Tama-chick.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、ちょっと！　それは聞きずてなりませんよ英里子さん。俺は純粋に日和子さんの作品が好きで読んだんですからね！」
lines.english: “H-hold on! I cannot let that pass, Eriko. I read Hiyoko's work because I sincerely enjoy it!”

lines.japanese: 「ホントかよ。どーせネットで適当なレビューでも拾って、いかにも自分の感想みたいな口振りしてるだけだろ」
lines.english: “Sure you did. Bet you just found some reviews online and started parroting them as your own opinions.”

lines.japanese: 「残念でしたー。今日もバッグん中に『ほほえみインサイド』と『米寿』両方入ってますぅー。嘘だと思うなら俺のロッカー開けて確認したっていいですよーだ」
lines.english: “Too bad. I've got both *Smile Inside* and *Eighty-Eight* in my bag right now. If you think I'm lying, go open my locker and see for yourself.”

lines.japanese: ちく、と感じた視線。
lines.english: I felt the tiny prick of somebody's gaze.

lines.japanese: あ、フロア巡回中の日和子さんが横目でこっち窺ってる。たぶん自分の著作名が聞こえて、会話の内容が気になったんだな。ふふふ日和子め、微笑ましいやつ。
lines.english: Ah. Hiyoko was making her circuit of the floor and watching us from the corner of her eye. She must have heard the titles of her books and grown curious. Heh heh. How endearing of you, Hiyoko.

lines.japanese: 「ねーねー、それじゃ千歳君はどっちが好き？　私は『ほほえみ』の方なんだけど」
lines.english: “Hey, Chitose, which do you like better? I prefer *Smile Inside*.”

lines.japanese: 「てか、フツーそっちでしょ」
lines.english: “I mean, that's the obvious choice.”

lines.japanese: 「俺もそっちはそっちで好きですけど、でもどっちがより好きかって質問なら、そりゃ断然『米寿』ですね」
lines.english: “I like that one too, but if you're asking which I prefer, *Eighty-Eight* wins by a mile.”

lines.japanese: お？　ずっとこっち見てるな日和子さん。よほど俺たちの会話が気になっているみたいだ。
lines.english: Oh? Hiyoko was still watching us. Our conversation must have fascinated her.

lines.japanese: よし、それなら彼女の耳にも届くように、ちょっと大きい声で喋ってあげよう。ふふふ、しかと聞くがいい、この俺の細川玉木に対する想いの丈を。
lines.english: Then I'd speak a little louder, so my words could reach her ears. Heh heh. Listen well, Hiyoko, and learn the full measure of my devotion to Tamaki Hosokawa.

lines.japanese: 「俺は『米寿』が大好きです！」
lines.english: “I love *Eighty-Eight*! Beige is beautiful!”

lines.japanese: 「へえー、おまえ変わった趣味してんな。あんなん好きなやつ、なかなかいねーぞ」
lines.english: “Huh. Weird taste. You won't find many people who are that into beige.”

lines.japanese: 「ひとの趣味はそれぞれっすからね。いいじゃないですか、ひとがなんと言おうと、俺は『米寿』を心から愛しています！」
lines.english: “To each his own. I don't care what anybody says—I love *Eighty-Eight*. I love beige with all my heart!”

lines.japanese: おっおっ、日和子さんがすたすた近づいてくる。ふふふ、さては俺の力説に感動したな。
lines.english: Oh, oh! Hiyoko was striding toward us. Heh heh. My impassioned declaration had plainly moved her.

lines.japanese: よし、かくなる上は最後のひと押しだ。
lines.english: Very well. One final push.

lines.japanese: 「とにかく時代はいま『米寿』です！　日和子さんの『米寿』は最高です！　俺はあの日以来『米寿』が頭に焼きついて離れません！」
lines.english: “Anyway, *Eighty-Eight* is the future! Nobody does beige like Hiyoko! Ever since that day, the image of her *Eighty-Eight* has been burned into my mind!”

lines.japanese: 「大きな声じゃ言えませんが、実はさっきもロッカールームで、こっそり細川玉木の『米寿』を舐めるように鑑賞してきました！　もちろん最高です！　今日も彼女の『米寿』は最高でしたァー！」
lines.english: “I can't say this too loudly, but earlier in the locker room, I secretly went over Tamaki Hosokawa's *Eighty-Eight* inch by inch. Naturally, it was magnificent! Her beige looked magnificent today too!”

lines.japanese: 「適当なこと……言わないでください……」
lines.english: “Please... don't just make things up...”
“What...?”

lines.japanese: <8>\「今日はピンクですっ！」
lines.english: “They're pink today!”

lines.japanese: <8>\「ぐぼはぁっ！」
lines.english: “Guhbwaaah!”

lines.japanese: 日和子さんの鋭いボディブローが、俺の鳩尾に突きささりました。
lines.english: Hiyoko's vicious body blow buried itself in my solar plexus.
“Wh-why...?”

lines.japanese: 来たとき同様、すたすたすたと足早に去ってゆく日和子さん。
lines.english: Hiyoko strode briskly away, just as briskly as she'd come.

lines.japanese: 「ちょっ……待っ……」
lines.english: “Wait... Please...”

lines.japanese: いや、あの……せめて、どうして俺は殴られたかだけでも……。
lines.english: No, um... At least tell me why I'd been punched...

lines.japanese: り、理由を……。
lines.english: The reason...

lines.japanese: 「あーあ。だから千歳ぇ、冗談でも下着見たとか見せろとか、そんな狩男以下のセクハラやめろって」
lines.english: “See, Chitose? I told you to knock off the sexual harassment. Even as a joke, claiming you've seen her underwear and demanding another look puts you below Karuo.”

lines.japanese: 「そうそう、イチゴとかベージュとか、大声で騒ぐのよくないよ」
lines.english: “Exactly. You shouldn't go shouting about strawberries and beige at the top of your lungs.”

lines.japanese: セクハラ……いつしたんだ、俺……。
lines.english: Sexual harassment...? When had I done any...?

lines.japanese: 身に覚えが……がくっ。
lines.english: I had no recollection... Ghh.

lines.japanese: 「それにしても千歳、なんか最近たまひよと仲よくない？」
lines.english: “Still, Chitose, haven't you and Tama-chick gotten awfully friendly lately?”

lines.japanese: 「え。まさかアナタさっきのやり取りを見てそう思ったんですか」
lines.english: “What? You watched that exchange and somehow reached that conclusion?”

lines.japanese: 「だってあいつ、千歳にはガンガン文句言うじゃん。私なんか相手にもされてないのに」
lines.english: “I mean, she's always laying into you. She won't even give me the time of day.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、それは流石の日和子さんとて、日野英里子の恐ろしさは知っているってだけでしょ」
lines.english: “Surely that only means even Hiyoko knows how terrifying Eriko Hino can be.”

lines.japanese: 「そうかあー？　どうせ相手にするだけ無駄とか思ってんじゃないの」
lines.english: “You think? Bet she just figures there's no point wasting her breath on me.”

lines.japanese: ははんと言いすてる英里子さん。そんな彼女に困り笑いの紀奈子さん。なんだかなあと矛先を自分へ向けさせる鷲介くん。
lines.english: Eriko delivered that verdict with a snort. Kinako gave her an awkward smile. And Shusuke, somehow, found himself in the crosshairs again.

lines.japanese: 「うーん、俺と日和子さんねえ……たしかに最初のころよりは幾らか軟化したかな、と思いますけど、まだまだ壁を感じるんですよ」
lines.english: “Mmm. Hiyoko and me... I do think she's softened a little since the beginning, but I still feel a wall between us.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、でもひよちゃんが男の子スタッフとあんなに話してるの、いままで見たことなかったよ」
lines.english: “Really? I’ve never seen Hiyo talk that much with a male staff member before.”

lines.japanese: 「たしかに。壁だったらあいつ、男女問わず誰にでも立ててるし」
lines.english: “True. But she puts walls up around everyone, men and women alike.”

lines.japanese: 「うん。すごいよね千歳君、あのひよちゃんを近付けさせちゃうなんて」
lines.english: “That’s amazing, Chitose. You actually managed to get Hiyo herself to open up this much.”

lines.japanese: 「千歳ー、面白いからおまえもう、たまひよと付きあっちゃえよ」
lines.english: “Hey, Chitose, it'd be funny. You should just start dating Tama-chick.”

lines.japanese: 「まじすか、英里子さんもたまにはいいこと言いますね」
lines.english: “Seriously? You do say something worthwhile on occasion, Eriko.”

lines.japanese: 「意外とお似合いのふたりっぽいよね」
lines.english: “You two are a surprisingly good match.”

lines.japanese: 「まじすか、どの辺がお似合いなんすか」
lines.english: “Seriously? What makes us a good match?”

lines.japanese: 「顔以外」
lines.english: “Everything but your faces.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと！　何気に傷付くこと言わないでくださいよ」
lines.english: “Hey! Don’t drop something that hurtful so casually.”

lines.japanese: 「でも、千歳君とひよちゃんがくっついたら展開ドラマちっくなのになー」
lines.english: “Still, if Chitose and Hiyo ended up together, it would make for quite a dramatic turn.”

lines.japanese: 「主役が冴えないけどね」
lines.english: “Pity about the dull protagonist.”

lines.japanese: 「いえいえ、俺は成長型の主人公なんですよ。後半から徐々に巻きかえすんですよ」
lines.english: “Please. I'm the kind of hero who grows into the role. My comeback starts in the second half.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな悠長なこと言ってていいのかなァ？　恋愛って、出会ってからのスピード勝負なところあるよ」
lines.english: “Can you really afford to take things that slowly? Romance is partly a race against the clock from the moment you meet.”

lines.japanese: 「そーすかあ？　気の合う男女がなんとなーく友情を育んでいって、気付いたらなんとなーくお互いを意識してて、みたいなじっくり築きあげる恋愛の方が多いんじゃないすかあ？」
lines.english: “Is it? I'd have thought most romances were built more slowly. A compatible man and woman drift into friendship, and before they know it they've somehow started seeing each other differently...”

lines.japanese: 「いや、逆だろ。だって、知り合ってから相手を異性として認識できる期間って限られてるじゃん」
lines.english: “No, it's the opposite. There's only a limited window after meeting someone when you can still start seeing them as a romantic possibility.”

lines.japanese: 「え、え、ちょっと難しいっす。どーゆーことすかソレ」
lines.english: “Wait, wait. That's too complicated. What does that mean?”

lines.japanese: 「だからね、たとえばある日、ＨちゃんがＳ君に初めて出会ったとするでしょ」
lines.english: “All right. Suppose a girl named H meets a guy named S for the first time.”

lines.japanese: 「ふむふむ、分かりやすいアルファベットっすな」
lines.english: “I see, I see. Very subtle choice of initials.”

lines.japanese: 「このあとＨちゃんがＳ君と恋に落ちる可能性があるとしたら、初めて会ったときから、うーん毎日会ってるようなもんだし、せいぜい１ヵ月ぐらいかな」
lines.english: “If there's any chance of H falling for S, then from the day they meet—hmm, since they see each other practically every day—I'd give it a month at most.”

lines.japanese: 「この期間を過ぎちゃったらもうムリです。ここまでに惚れてなかったら、あとはＳ君がどんなに頑張ってもＨちゃんは振りむきません」
lines.english: “Once that window closes, it’s over. If she hasn’t fallen for him by then, nothing S does afterward will ever make her look his way.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？　なんで？」
lines.english: “What? Why?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、なんでとかじゃなくて。理由なんかないし」
lines.english: “There is no ‘why.’ There isn't a reason.”

lines.japanese: 「とにかく恋愛ってそういうモンだもん。いったん友達とか仲間とかどうでもいいひとって認識が完成しちゃったら、そのあとはもう、なかなか恋愛のスイッチ入んないよ」
lines.english: “That's simply how romance works. Once she's filed him away as a friend, a colleague, or somebody who doesn't matter, it becomes terribly hard to flip the romance switch afterward.”

lines.japanese: 「う、嘘だ、極論すぎる！」
lines.english: “Th-that’s absurd! That’s way too extreme!”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、まあね。それはちょっと大袈裟かもだけど、でも女の子はとくにそういうタイプ多いよ」
lines.english: “Ha ha. Well, yes, that may be a little exaggerated. But lots of girls work that way.”

lines.japanese: 「まーそうね。いいひとだと思われたら終わりっていうか？」
lines.english: “Yeah, pretty much. Once she decides you're a nice guy, it's over.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ！　いいひと駄目なんすか！」
lines.english: “What!? Being nice is bad!?”

lines.japanese: 「面白いひとも駄目だよね」
lines.english: “Being funny is bad too.”

lines.japanese: 「面白いひとも！？」
lines.english: “Being funny too!?”

lines.japanese: 「たまひよなんか、とくに固定観念つよそうじゃん？　あいつに一度そういう相手だと思われたら、まァ覆せそうにないよね」
lines.english: “And Tama-chick seems especially set in her assumptions, doesn't she? Once she decides what sort of person you are, I doubt you'll ever change her mind.”

lines.japanese: 「あの、すいません……さっきから急に俺を焦らせて、いったい何がしたいんですかアナタ方は」
lines.english: “Um, excuse me... Why are you two suddenly trying to make me panic? What exactly are you trying to accomplish?”

lines.japanese: 「やー、ひよちゃんはいろいろ考えなくていいことまで考えちゃう子だし、あの壁を突きやぶるには勢いも必要かなーって。長期戦向きじゃないよね」
lines.english: “Well, Hiyo thinks herself into knots over things she doesn't even need to consider. I figured breaking through that wall might require momentum. She's not suited to a long campaign.”

lines.japanese: 「そーそー、一応これは正論だぞ千歳。だって、ねえ紀奈子さん？　実際うちらも、いまさら千歳をオトコとして意識するのとか無理でしょ」
lines.english: “Exactly. For once, this is sound advice, Chitose. Right, Kinako? At this point, neither of us could ever see Chitose that way.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、えりちゃん何気にひどーい。たぶんその通りだけど」
lines.english: “Ha ha! That was casually brutal, Eri. Probably true, though.”

lines.japanese: 笑われてる。もしかしてここは怒っていいとこなのかもしれません。
lines.english: They were laughing at me. Perhaps this was an occasion when anger would be justified.

lines.japanese: 「でも、それは千歳君の方だって同じでしょ？」
lines.english: “But the same is true for you, isn't it, Chitose?”
“Huh? Me?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、私たちのこと恋愛対象として見られる？」
lines.english: “Right. Could you still see either of us as someone you'd date?”
